zalo_guide_subtitle: The system will automatically block blurry compressed images to ensure the aesthetics of the school Web. Please follow these instructions:
zalo_ios_step_1: Open the Photos app, select the photo to send, click Share, and select Save to file.
zalo_ios_step_2: In the Zalo chat frame, press Plus sign (+).
zalo_ios_step_3: Select Document (or File) → Find the photo you just saved in Files to send.
zalo_android_step_1: In the Zalo chat box, press Plus sign (+) or 3 dots (...).
zalo_android_step_3: Select the photo to send to send as the original file.
zalo_pc_step_1: Click on the Attach file icon (Paper clip).
zalo_pc_step_2: Select Choose File and find the photo you want to send.
